policy: Only explicitly listed, freshly inventoried candidates with verified archive and restore receipts may become eligible. This file cannot delete anything.

externalPrerequisites.taskbuddy_api_migration_verified: TaskBuddy must prove that the retained v5.39 and v5.36 frontends are human-approved and correctly rebound to every still-required production API and worker. The isolated demo and v5.23 data planes must remain isolated or be migrated with separate evidence. This repository does not perform that application migration.
externalPrerequisites.minday_admin_secret_migration_verified: Minday's legacy .env.local is never archived with release code. It must be migrated to a separately protected release-external secret and its rebind verified before the legacy release can become cleanup-eligible.
